name: spec-architect
description: Evidence-based architecture and design specification for a single implementation. Five-phase process (Research, Blueprint, Requirements, Design, Validation) produces research.md, blueprint.md, requirements.md, and design.md with a component-level requirements traceability matrix, then validates every acceptance criterion is implemented by a named component and every research claim is cited. Scoped to the 'what' and 'how' of the system's shape only — no execution plan, milestones, or task sequencing.

interface.longDescription: Turn a Definition of Done, PRD, or stated requirements into an architecture specification through Research, Blueprint, Requirements, Design, and Validation. A bundled Python 3 validator checks requirements coverage, references, component names, and cited evidence. Validation remains pending if script execution is unavailable. Execution planning is a separate step.
interface.defaultPrompt: Design and validate an architecture specification from my requirements or Definition of Done.
